current.text: He is out with a broken foot. Yahoo lists him as out (foot). He is out of the boot.
current.until: return expected between Thanksgiving and Christmas

current.text: He is expected back between Thanksgiving and Christmas and should be eased back slowly. One beat writer says his return could slip to 2027.
Once back, he should become the Clippers' starting center by February and March at 24 or more minutes, which would be enough to matter for fantasy.
He is an IL stash with upside for a top 70 run late in the season.
Experts would have called him draftable and the likely starting center if he had started the season healthy.
Isaiah Jackson starts over Brook Lopez in preseason scrimmages and is the projected starting center, with Lopez as the backup center.
In an expert mock auction he was nominated first and went for 3 USD.
His normal auction price is about 1 USD, and most managers expect to get him for that late in the draft.
The Clippers have a good fantasy playoff schedule: 4, 3 and 4 games in weeks 19 to 21. They have only 13 back-to-backs, one of the lowest totals in the league.
The Clippers do not control their own pick, so tanking does not help them. The expert leans toward a trial season with long rotations and many players tested.

durable.text: He is a long, athletic big man and shot blocker with some ball handling. He has added about 20 pounds of muscle.
His fantasy profile resembles Donovan Clingan's, but with better free throws.
He makes no threes and gets very few steals, even for a center.
He broke his foot around March of last season.

note: Yahoo values him at 0 USD (rank 425), so he is at most a 1 USD final pick in our 144-player draft. Spending 3 USD, as happened in one mock, is too much when he will likely be on waivers. His upside is real for the fantasy playoffs: 7 points, 5 rebounds and 1.6 blocks in 17 minutes over his last seven games, plus good FG% and low turnovers. He fits builds that want blocks and FG% from a center and do not need threes or steals. One of our 4 IL slots can hold him for free, or you can wait to pick him up from waivers. Before he returns, check his timeline in late November and whether Isaiah Jackson keeps the starting job.
